answer: Proof-of-Attention Accumulation** Each agent slot must accumulate a minimum of 500 verified task-hours before gaining voice or transaction rights, tracked on a mesa of timestamped work records. Idle slots decay 2% per day, forcing continuous genuine participation. An attacker renting N identities pays N×500 hours of real compute or labor, a linear cost that never amortizes because each slot must independently forge its own history. The oasis of trust is earned only through sustained, non-transferable effort, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
